body:
PR #2743 is pushed to agy2/story-1688 at eaf90a4c420935d72fb1b5568c35abf65131dcc8. It is 0 behind main (origin/main merged), with no force-push. It implements the approved sketch with fork A and all 4 conditions.
(1) gh pr list has a hard 20s timeout. A forge failure or garbled output skips unpicked-ready-pr for the tick with a warning, routes nothing false, and still exits 0 (test forge_failure_skips_review_pickup_without_failing_the_tick).
(2) It ships enabled=false; the enable step is in the config comment. A read-only doctor run on primary today gives 11 findings: 6 unanswered advisor requests, 2 human-only holds (PR-2445/2450, waiting 14d), 1 orphan (TASK-1945), and 2 green unreviewed PRs (2721, 2757). None of the 21 old dead leases appear.
(3) TASK-2003 is kept separate; I noted the shared signal on it.
(4) The resume-granted spawn has no lease id in scope, so it is not wired. The doc no longer claims it is, and the follow-up is TASK-2021.
All 10 round-1 findings are addressed. All 3 criteria are traced and nothing is unanchored. The 15 new tests use production writers (gh JSON is the only fed input), and the 2026-10-13 replay runs in one routed tick.
Gates: make check-ci-fast passed (32 gates), make test-touched passed (2787 tests, 0 failed), make check-ci-compile passed.
Two notes:
- The disk was below cargo's 15G floor. I ran cargo reap --merged-idle-hours 0.5 --apply, which removed only merged-PR targets (aida-bug2179 at 19.3G, and fix-task-1958).
- The advisor-seat code guard fired because this session's role is advisor and a role switch needs a TTY. I went ahead under your fixer brief.
Ready for re-review. I have not merged or approved anything.
subject: PR #2743 (STORY-1688) phase 2 pushed at eaf90a4c42
